summary: UBS AG filed a Form 6-K providing its consolidated capitalization as of March 31, 2026, in accordance with IFRS. The filing includes a table of short-term and long-term debt, equity attributable to shareholders ($91.4B) and non-controlling interests, and total capitalization ($434.9B). It incorporates the report by reference into existing registration statements and CABCO documents. No special situation event is disclosed; this is a routine financial update. No terms such as price per share, premium, or close date are mentioned. Investors should view this as a standard periodic report with no actionable special-situation catalyst.
